reviewer: independent read-only G7 field-type contract review

findings.title: G7 model-output stage parser accepted malformed nested V/L/U fields
findings.evidence: Before the type check was added, the G7 output contract validated only key presence for revised_claim and supporting_evidence. The design-aligned data report requires revised_claim to be string/null and supporting_evidence to be a string; a read-only scan of the immutable protocol-corrected checkpoint payload found 22/184 rows with non-string or empty supporting_evidence (dict/list/None). Historical artifacts remain unchanged and non-confirmatory.
findings.remediation: Require revised_claim to be string or null and supporting_evidence to be a nonempty string in the arm-specific output contract; retain invalid responses through the bounded format-retry path and never rewrite historical rows.
